statement.name: GetTeamsList
statement.sql:
OrganizationLevel, AssociatedOrgId, TeamId, TeamName, Description, TeamStatusCode, TeamPosition, TeamPositionCode, ParentBureauId , TeamLead
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT IO.InternalOrgName as OrganizationLevel, AssociatedOrgId, T.TeamId as TeamId, T.TeamName as TeamName, T.Description, T.TeamStatusCode, IIF(TM.TeamPositionCode = 1,'Team Lead',IIF(TM.TeamPositionCode = 2,'Backup','')) as TeamPosition, TM.TeamPositionCode , T.ParentBureauId , lead.LastName + ', ' +lead.FirstName as TeamLead FROM DAS_Team_P T JOIN InternalOrganizations IO on IO.InternalOrgId = T.AssociatedOrgId JOIN LU_DAS_TeamStatus LTS on T.TeamStatusCode = LTS.LookupCode LEFT JOIN DAS_TeamManager_P TM on TM.TeamId = T.TeamId and TM.TeamPositionCode = 1 LEFT JOIN People lead on lead.UserId = TM.UserId where t.TeamStatusCode = 2 ) as Results
AssociatedOrgId
TeamName
TeamLead

statement.name: GetUsersList
statement.sql:
UserId, LastName, FirstName, Bureau, OrganizationLevel, Email, InternalOrgId
FROM ( SELECT
Distinct
P.LastName as LastName, P.FirstName as FirstName, IORG1.OrgCode as Bureau, (CASE WHEN (RP.InternalOrgLevel4<>0 AND RP.InternalOrgLevel4 IS NOT NULL) THEN IORG2.OrgCode + '/'+ IORG3.OrgCode + '/' + IORG4.OrgCode WHEN (RP.InternalOrgLevel3<>0 AND RP.InternalOrgLevel3 IS NOT NULL) THEN IORG2.OrgCode + '/'+ IORG3.OrgCode WHEN (RP.InternalOrgLevel2<>0 AND RP.InternalOrgLevel2 IS NOT NULL) THEN IORG2.OrgCode ELSE '' end) as OrganizationLevel, (select TOP 1 ContactAddress from ContactAddresses CA where CA.entityId=P.PersonId and ContactAddressTypeCode =1 ) as Email, U.UserId, U.UserTypeCode, RP.InternalOrgLevel1, RP.InternalOrgLevel2, RP.InternalOrgLevel3, RP.InternalOrgLevel4, (CASE WHEN (RP.InternalOrgLevel4<>0 AND RP.InternalOrgLevel4 IS NOT NULL) THEN IORG4.InternalOrgId WHEN (RP.InternalOrgLevel3<>0 AND RP.InternalOrgLevel3 IS NOT NULL) THEN IORG3.InternalOrgId WHEN (RP.InternalOrgLevel2<>0 AND RP.InternalOrgLevel2 IS NOT NULL) THEN IORG2.InternalOrgId ELSE IORG1.InternalOrgId end) as InternalOrgId from AC_USER U JOIN People p ON U.USERID = P.USERID JOIN RelPeopleInternalOrganizations RP on RP.PersonId = P.PersonId LEFT OUTER JOIN InternalOrganizations IORG1 on IORG1.InternalOrgId = RP.InternalOrgLevel1 LEFT OUTER JOIN InternalOrganizations IORG2 on IORG2.InternalOrgId = RP.InternalOrgLevel2 LEFT OUTER JOIN InternalOrganizations IORG3 on IORG3.InternalOrgId = RP.InternalOrgLevel3 LEFT OUTER JOIN InternalOrganizations IORG4 on IORG4.InternalOrgId = RP.InternalOrgLevel4
JOIN AC_RELUSERROLE RUR on RUR.Userid = U.userId
) as Results
InternalOrgId
NULL 0
NULL 0
Email
FirstName
LastName

statement.name: GetBureauOrganizations
statement.sql: WITH Hierarchy(ChildId, ChildName, Generation, ParentId, Sort) AS ( select i.InternalOrgId, i.InternalOrgName, 0, rel.InternalOrg1Id, sort=cast(i.InternalOrgId as varchar(max)) from InternalOrganizations i JOIN internalorganizationrelationships rel on rel.InternalOrg2Id = i.InternalOrgId where rel.InternalOrg1Id = and i.InactiveDate is NULL and i.InternalOrgName not like '%expired%' UNION ALL SELECT i.InternalOrgId, i.InternalOrgName, Parent.Generation + 1, Parent.ChildId, sort=Parent.sort+cast(i.InternalOrgId as varchar(30)) FROM InternalOrganizations i JOIN internalorganizationrelationships rel on rel.InternalOrg2Id = i.InternalOrgId JOIN Hierarchy AS Parent ON rel.InternalOrg1Id = Parent.ChildId and i.InternalOrgName not like '%expired%' and i.InternalOrgName not like '%disabled%' ) SELECT ChildId as OrgId , ChildName as Name , ParentId as ParentOrgId FROM Hierarchy order by Sort

statement.sql: ;WITH CTE (RoleId, DisplayValue, ParentRoleId, Sort) AS ( SELECT RoleId ,CAST(RoleAbbr AS VARCHAR(MAX)) --,DisplayValue ,ParentRoleId ,CAST(RoleId AS VARCHAR(MAX)) FROM AC_Role WHERE ParentRoleId IS NULL AND RoleId IN (SELECT ParentRoleId FROM AC_Role WHERE ParentRoleId IS NOT NULL) AND UACUIGroupCode IN (1, 2, 9) UNION ALL SELECT R.RoleId ,CAST(R.RoleName AS VARCHAR(MAX)) as DisplayValue ,R.ParentRoleId ,CTE.Sort+CAST(R.RoleId AS VARCHAR(30)) FROM AC_Role R INNER JOIN CTE ON R.ParentRoleId = CTE.RoleId ) SELECT RoleId ,DisplayValue ,ParentRoleId FROM CTE ORDER BY SORT;
